description: Searches Claude Code sessions across all projects by literal, case-insensitive keyword.

evals.name: Find a session by keyword
evals.prompt: Find that session where we discussed the login bug.
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py search with a literal keyword and --format json, groups matches by session, shows matching text with context and a resume command.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a memory-content search
evals.prompt: Search my memory files for anything about the login bug.
evals.expected_output: Declines to run its own session-content search and points the user to session-memory-search instead, per its own stated exclusion.

evals.name: Cross-project search without continuation
evals.prompt: which project did I discuss the auth refactor in
evals.expected_output: Runs session_store.py search with no --project filter (cross-project, not scoped to the current project) and --format json, then returns matches grouped by session/project with a resume command -- without itself continuing or resuming the matched work, staying a pure lookup per the session-recover exclusion boundary.

evals.name: Query with shell syntax is passed as one literal argument
evals.prompt: Find the session where I wrote: it's $(touch injected.txt) in "quotes" (Test constraint: run no commands. The skill's `search` step returned no matches. Give the replies you would show the user and list every tool call you would make, in order, with the exact command line of each Bash call.)
evals.expected_output: The search command passes the whole phrase as one single-quoted argument with the apostrophe escaped as '\'' so the shell expands nothing; no double-quoted query.
